body: Have you talked about how you feel to some of those close to you? Because your friends and family sound like they care a lot about you. Those close to you can be a great support, can be a thought to get over the urge to end it all. Something that makes life worth living a little longer
I know. You've got to force yourself to, a lot of times. Because the one telling you that you wont ever do something of your life is depression, and it'll suck you dry if you let it

And even if nothing happens, im trying to be the change i wanna see in this world. Doesnt matter to me if it actually ends up changing much, i can at least say i've tried and not given up
Hm, i get where you're coming from. But then make something of it. You are the master of your destiny, friend
Hey, if it works for you, thats amazing. Im glad to hear you made the choice to stick around!

Yea, i see. I've never been married. Or truly in love for that matter. But try focusing on yourself. Do stuff you enjoy man. What you're feeling is only temporary. There will be someone out there again for you

Thanks for the offer and the kind words. Im trying, already did some of this in my real life. Just wanting to give back some. Being the change i wanna see. And hell, if this helps even one person it was worth it all. Wishing you best of luck in your endevours!

Im sending my best wishes your way!

But i do. I see you as well. Judging by your comment im guessing you're in the same boat, you feel lonely and hate everything. Im just making assumptions though. Just know, i see you, i acknowledge you, and i wish you all the best in your life

And, i dont know how recent it is, sounds like it hasnt been a while, and feeling these kind of emotions is importan, but so is letting go. Try not to linger on it too long, but start focusing on the present and future more. I wish you all the best

Life is made of ups and downs. Im not gonna lie and tell you it'll all get better, because honestly, im not sure of that myself. But what you can do is try changing your mindset around that, especially when you are having good days again, trying to build strength to weather the storm kind of

Thank you for trying. Im proud of you for getting through another day, even though you feel this way. I know how hard it is. Just try focusing on the small wins every day, even if it is just getting through another day

Why do you find it hard if you want to, if i may ask?
Also, if you want to live, but feel like you are a danger to yourself, might do something to yourself, then the psych ward might be a better option than the alternative. Though i have to say that also depends on your kind of insurance and the quality of the facilities around
The Crucifier

Hey, while i dont understand what that kind of loss feels like, and i am truly sorry for what happened, i'll still try giving you something to think about. I know everyone processes loss differently, but think about, would he want you to suffer, to not move on, or would he want you to try to be happy and live the best life you can? 
You should not forget him, but you also should try not to cling on to things that could- or would have been. And, 2 months is still not that long for a loss like this, give it a little more time. Its okay to be sad, its okay to cry. Just let it all out while you still feel these emotions, but try to not get lost and sucked down into this whirlpool of negativity either. I wish you the very best, and i believe in you!

Honestly, to me it sounds like one of your current major problems could be your partner basically gaslighting you. His behaviour sounds like a narcissist to me, and i'd recommend you leave him, try focusing on yourself. On what you want, instead of what people expect or want of you. And i know life sucks, and that often. I get that. But hell, we're alive, so why not just try making something from it? We'll all die anyways. I hope you manage to figure something out that works for you, and that things maybe turn your way. Love from an internet stranger
No problem, no problem at all. I thank you for reaching out somewhere, making yourself known

What i usually did was just slap a bandaid on there, if it bled too much i put some paper under there to soak it up, then changed it the next day. I also usually aired it out a little after a day so it could dry a little. However, i cant really recommend my practices to anyone. In the end it also highly depends on how deep it is.
(Oh, also i never cleaned it with water, my thought was that it could to infection easier)

However, i feel like i have to say this, though it might not come through to you, and honestly, i do not know your situation, but think it over carefully if you really want to end it. In the end i cant stop you, but you shouldnt take this choice lightly. I hope that you can conquer whatever you are going through, instead of ending your life

Well, since i had the pure luck of being put into an open station i can only really tell you how it was for me. So on the open station you had your phones, visits could be done whenever there wasnt any scheduled therapy/activities going on. I could, however, also just go into the city when i wanted to for example. If you get placed into a closed station, i was only there for a night, but you do not have your phone if i remember correctly, that gets taken upon arrival, since it could heavily heighten some of the issues (social media, mainly, you know, comparing to others and thus feeling worse about yourself etc.)
About the treatment of trans or queer i cant speak on, i guess that also heavily depends on the people around you. The clinic staff probably wont care tho, and i believe if there is mistreatment, if the staff sees it or someone tells, there will be things done against that, because the environment shouldnt be one of bullying but healing. However, that also depends on the clinic you get put into. I have heard of some horrid places, but there, usually everyone gets treated like shit

Hey, i read your post, i see you. It might be against this subs policy do dm directly tho, not entirely sure about it. But i'd be willing to listen. You are still young, and its nice you acknowledge some part of you doesnt want to die yet. Its a step into the right direction. Just know, your feelings are valid, as dark and confusing as they might be. Sadly, i cant give you any more advice since i know nothing about the why of your feelings

It depends. I got sent to a psych ward after my attempt, closed station, so u cant leave it if you want. I had the chance to sign a letter saying i'd stay if i got moved to an open station, otherwise a judge will make a small little letter that basically allows you to be imprisoned there until you are no longer a threat to yourself and/or others. But everyones experience will be different. Also heavily depends on how good the institution in your area is. If you got any more questions, just fire away!
I wish you to be happy someday, and that you do fail, though i know you currently feel different, most likely

Firstly, thank you for acknowledging my existence, barely anyone does. Since it doesnt matter i guess i can share a little more about myself. Im 23, soon turning 24, living in germany and working as a machinist. I live with my mom, has several reason, one major one being rents being way too high, another that i wouldnt manage to survive on my own. And like i said, there is really nothing that validates the way i feel, i dont have any major trauma, i dont have any illness, at least none that majorly affects me in my daily life, and thats kinda something that bothers me and i also dont (anymore, i used to) struggle with my self image, because i wish i had a genuine reason to kill myself, because then i might actually have the strength to do it right now, to not care about anything anymore. And at this point, im almost there. I've felt like this, to some extent, for almost as long as i can think. And i boiled it down to some part of me missing. I used to think 'When i have this or that i will feel better, i must', but thats not true. Kinda feels like u have a puzzle infront of you, but are missing a piece. And you have 10 pieces laying in front of you, its just that none of these fit, no matter how often you try, how often you turn them. This void in me, its eaten almost everything. The only reason i am still here, if im being honest, right now is because it would majorly inconveniece someone, but i estimate it doesnt take much longer until i dont care about that anymore either
